baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative iqra is joined by bi-smi, rabbika, and the relative clause identifying the Lord as the one who created.
baseline_models.mechanism: Reading or recitation is not left as an autonomous vocal act: the prepositional phrase places it within the Creator-Lord's designation and authority.

activation_trace.role: Reading, reciting, and teaching recitation supply the commanded act and its transmissible voice.
A name as a raised designation supplies the identifier under which the recitation proceeds.
Lordship, ownership, and authority make the named relation one of authorization and answerability.
Originating and bringing into being identifies the authority as the source of the reader and the readable world.

changed_reading.after: Read or recite as sourced, authorized speech in the designation of your Creator-Lord.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Iqra, bi-smi, rabbika, and khalaqa can be held together through gathering, marking, measured formation, and completion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command asks the reader to gather distinguishable marks into intelligible order; the Lord is the one who measures that order and nurtures it to completion. The name is therefore both designation and a cue to legibility.

activation_trace.role: Collecting and gathering recast reading as joining dispersed elements into a coherent whole.
A visible identifying mark makes bi-smi activate the material sign by which something becomes distinguishable.
A sign read by discerning observation turns the mark into evidence requiring interpretation.
Measuring and proportioning supply the ordered relations that gathered marks can disclose.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the Lord the agent who brings partial signs into finished intelligibility.

changed_reading.before: Decode an already given text while mentioning God.
changed_reading.after: Gather the measured marks of created order into an intelligible articulation under the identifying name of the one completing them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command addresses a reader in relation to rabbika and closes with creation, allowing the act to form the reader as well as convey content.
baseline_models.mechanism: Reading becomes an apprenticeship: the Lord nurtures knowledge and the act reshapes the reader's inward disposition. The object being formed is not only an utterance but a learned, devotional person.

activation_trace.role: The devout or learned reader supplies a human formation produced through sustained reading.
Stagewise nurture and completion make reading a process by which the addressee is cultivated.
Knowledge formed through lordly care links the Lord-reader relation directly to cultivated understanding.
Inner disposition and character make creation include the reader's moral form, not only external objects.

changed_reading.before: Reading transfers information to an unchanged reader.
changed_reading.after: Read as an apprenticeship through which your Lord cultivates knowledge and recreates the reader's disposition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The q-r-hamza inventory contains enclosure and reproductive-cycle images while rabb and khalaqa supply nurture and completed form.
baseline_models.mechanism: Reading can be imagined as carrying gathered material within an enclosure until a proportioned form emerges. This does not replace recitation; it gives recitation a gestational temporality of retention, development, and emergence.

activation_trace.role: A womb enclosing a pregnancy supplies the carrying enclosure for gathered meaning.
A reproductive cycle supplies time and phased transition rather than instantaneous decoding.
Nourishing and growing up supply the developmental action attributed to the Lord.
Complete, well-proportioned form supplies the outcome toward which the carried reading develops.

changed_reading.after: Carry and gather meaning under lordly nurture until a formed reading can emerge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation from attached, womb-fixed material makes the focus's gestational gathering less isolated: formed human life begins in dependence, so reading too can begin by attaching and retaining rather than claiming immediate mastery.

activation_trace.role: The focus-root image of a womb enclosing pregnancy anchors the reading process in gestational carrying.
Repeated originating makes the next material specification an expansion of the focus Creator clause.
Attachment and clinging supply dependence as the mechanism by which unformed material remains connected.
A pregnancy fixed in the womb materially reinforces the focus-root enclosure image.

structural_cues: 96:2 repeats creation and specifies a human origin from attached material immediately after the unspecific 'created' of 96:1.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated creation plus attachment and gestation; I map that biological dependence back onto q-r-hamza as a model of how reading forms. A live alternative is that 96:2 specifies creation only and leaves iqra semantically unchanged.

changed_reading.before: The gestational branch is a remote focus-only image.
changed_reading.after: Read by attaching, retaining, and developing material into form, as created human life itself begins through dependent attachment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated imperative is followed not by a demand for prior competence but by the Lord's superlative generosity. Recitation becomes a renewed capacity granted within the Lord-reader relation.

activation_trace.role: The first recitation command supplies the act that will be repeated and re-enabled.
The second occurrence literally repeats reading or recitation, making iteration part of the mechanism.
Nurture and completion make the repeated command an assisted development rather than a bare test.
Praiseworthy generosity supplies the giver-side cause for renewed reading.

structural_cues: 96:3 repeats iqra and places 'your Lord is the most generous' directly after it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition, nurture, and generosity; I infer that generosity enables renewed performance rather than merely praising the Lord alongside it. The alternative is simple emphatic repetition.

changed_reading.before: The imperative tests whether the addressee already possesses reading ability.
changed_reading.after: Read again because the nurturing Lord's generosity supplies and renews the capacity to read.

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching makes marks disclose knowledge, while the pen is a hard thing trimmed into an instrument. Measured creation and written inscription become parallel operations: both proportion material, leave differentiating traces, and make an order readable.

activation_trace.role: Gathering supplies the reader's action of joining discrete marks into an ordered whole.
A visible identifying mark supplies the shared semiotic material of naming and inscription.
Measuring before action supplies the formal parallel between creating and composing an inscription.
A distinguishing trace that guides supplies the bridge from material mark to taught knowledge.
Cutting and trimming hard material to level it supplies the pen's formative technology.
The trimmed writing stick turns shaped material into the instrument that leaves readable traces.
Disclosure to a knower makes reading an event in which what was unknown becomes manifest.

structural_cues: 96:4 names teaching by the pen, and 96:5 repeats teaching across a before-and-after contrast of not knowing and knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation, marked distinction, a trimmed writing instrument, and disclosed knowledge; I infer a common operation of forming legible order. The alternative keeps creation and inscription as separate divine acts linked only by agency.

changed_reading.before: Read a text that is unrelated in kind to the act of creation.
changed_reading.after: Read by gathering shaped marks, recognizing inscription and creation as parallel disclosures of measured order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human sees himself as self-sufficient, crosses limits, and yet returns to the Lord. Against that sequence, bi-smi rabbika becomes a provenance discipline that prevents the reader from treating knowledge, voice, or competence as self-originating property.

activation_trace.role: The raised designation supplies explicit attribution that counters anonymous or self-owned speech.
Lordship and ownership identify the source to whom the act and capacity remain accountable.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the failure that proper attribution is inferred to restrain.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the self-assessment on which the false autonomy claim rests.
Self-sufficiency supplies the imagined independence that reverses the focus's 'your Lord' relation.
The repeated Lord relation restores ownership and authority after the self-sufficiency claim.
Return to a prior source closes the provenance loop and denies final autonomy.

structural_cues: 96:6-8 forms a causal sequence: human transgression follows perceived self-sufficiency, then the text names return to your Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies designation, lordship, transgression, self-perception, self-sufficiency, and return; I infer that naming the Lord regulates ownership of reading and knowledge. The alternative treats bi-smi only as an invocation without an anti-autonomy function.

changed_reading.before: Mention the Lord's name as a prefatory formula.
changed_reading.after: Read with explicit provenance so that acquired knowledge does not become a fiction of self-sufficiency or unrestricted ownership.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated seeing and knowing turn reading into adjudication among perspectives: the human sees himself one way, the listener is repeatedly asked to inspect a scene, and God sees. The readable mark is therefore evidence under reciprocal scrutiny, not inert data.

activation_trace.role: A sign read by discerning observation anchors the focus command in evidence visible to an interpreter.
Reading and reciting supply the focal act that the repeated seeing questions deepen.
The heart's opinion and reflection expose seeing as interpretation capable of a false conclusion.
The attention-getting inquiry makes the addressee inspect and judge the represented action.
Disclosure to a knower frames the final question as failed recognition rather than missing information alone.
Divine seeing supplies the encompassing witness before which human reading and action are accountable.

structural_cues: The sequence alternates a person's self-seeing, repeated 'have you seen?' questions, knowing, and God's seeing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies multiple acts of seeing plus a focus-root sign discerned by observation; I infer that iqra trains accountable judgment across competing viewpoints. The alternative is that the seeing formulas are rhetorical transitions with no revision of reading.

changed_reading.before: Reading decodes marks from a single neutral viewpoint.
changed_reading.after: Read as accountable discernment: test self-perception and public appearance against the fact that the reader is also seen.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prohibiting agent tries to stop a servant engaged in prayer, while the servant may be guided and command protective piety. The first imperative is thus drawn into a contest of commands; naming the Lord identifies which authority governs obedience.

activation_trace.role: The initial recitation imperative supplies the command whose authority the later prohibition puts at stake.
Lordship and obeyed authority identify the higher claimant governing the reciter.
Prohibition and restraint supply the rival command attempting to block embodied devotion.
Submissive worship and obedience identify the prohibited person's active allegiance.
The specific act of worship makes the conflict bodily and public rather than merely intellectual.
Gentle direction toward the path and truth supplies a positive orientation for the servant's action.
Request and obligation mirror the focus imperative and make command itself a contested social force.
Protection from harm supplies the aim of the servant's counter-command.

structural_cues: 96:9-12 moves from prohibition of a servant at prayer to the possibilities of guidance and commanding protective piety.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a divine imperative, a human prohibition, worship, guidance, and another command; I infer a hierarchy of commands resolved by rabbika. The alternative is that later conflict concerns prayer alone and does not retroactively politicize iqra.

changed_reading.before: Read as a private cognitive or devotional exercise.
changed_reading.after: Read under the Creator-Lord's authority as an allegiance that can require resisting a rival prohibition and issuing a protective counter-command.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root for creating also carries a branch of fabricating speech. Later lying and error activate the polarity within that root: recitation in the Creator's name is a provenance test separating received, measured formation from self-fabricated discourse, with responsibility attached to an embodied agent.

activation_trace.role: True originating and bringing into being supply one pole of the creation-fabrication contrast.
Fabricated false speech supplies the latent rival mode of producing words.
Recitation supplies the speech event whose source and truth status must be distinguished.
Contradiction of truth activates false speech as an explicit contextual alternative.
The forelock and seizure by it locate false production in an embodied, answerable agent.
Missing what is right supplies the directional failure paired with lying.

structural_cues: 96:13 introduces denial, and 96:16 grammatically attributes lying and error to the forelock named in the preceding threat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both originating and false-fabrication branches under kh-l-q, then explicit lying, error, and an embodied locus; I infer that 'in the name' marks truthful provenance. The alternative leaves the false-fabrication branch inactive because focus khalaqa denotes divine creation.

changed_reading.before: Recitation is judged mainly by fluency or content.
changed_reading.after: Read in a way that declares provenance and refuses to fabricate speech under the authority of the one who truly creates.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opponent calls an assembly and receives a counter-call of repelling agents. Against q-r-hamza's gathering image, the first recitation can be heard as performative speech that gathers allegiance and enters a contest between rival convocations.

activation_trace.role: Collecting and gathering anchor recitation as an act capable of assembling more than words.
Lordship and authority identify the allegiance under which the focus gathering occurs.
Calling and drawing by speech supply the opponent's performative means of mobilization.
A people gathered in council supplies the social body summoned by the rival call.
The answering call mirrors and reverses the opponent's attempted mobilization.
Pushing, striking, and preventing give the counter-convocation coercive force.

structural_cues: 96:17-18 balances two first-position forms of 'call': let him call his council; We shall call the repelling force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering in iqra, a summoned council, a mirrored counter-call, and repelling agents; I infer that voiced recitation can convene allegiance. The alternative confines gathering to lexical history and treats both calls only as threat dialogue.

changed_reading.before: Read as a solitary handling of words.
changed_reading.after: Recite as speech that gathers a public under the Creator-Lord's authority and exposes the rival assembly it confronts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence refuses one obedience, commands prostration, and commands approach. It turns the opening reading into the first movement of an embodied trajectory: receive the higher command, lower the body, and draw near.

activation_trace.role: The devout or learned reader anchors recitation in a practiced form of devotion.
Lordship supplies the authority toward whom the reader's obedience and approach are directed.
Submission and obedience supply the rejected allegiance whose refusal clarifies the opening command.
Lowering and humility convert verbal reception into bodily submission.
Nearness rather than distance supplies the trajectory's endpoint.
An offering or act of approach to God gives the final nearness an explicitly devotional vector.

structural_cues: 96:19 closes with three coordinated imperatives: do not obey him, prostrate, and draw near.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed obedience, bodily lowering, and approach; I infer that these complete a trajectory begun by iqra. The alternative treats the final imperatives as independent commands rather than the opening command's embodied completion.

changed_reading.before: Reading ends when the utterance or cognition is complete.
changed_reading.after: Reading initiates an obedience that becomes bodily prostration, refusal of rival authority, and movement toward nearness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links distant material branches rather than proposing a lexical translation. It remains anchored in focus images of appointed reading-time, the Lord's cloud, and a created water-holding hollow, while context supplies overflow, returning rain, a terminal basin, and a water vessel. Downstream prose should present it only as an ecological analogy for regulated flow and return.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Iqra's appointed-season branch, rabb's cloud branch, and khalaqa's water-holding hollow permit a focus-level image of timed collection under a sustaining Lord.

activation_trace.role: An appointed time or season supplies periodicity to the act of reading.
A low or layered rain cloud supplies the sustaining source above the cycle.
A hollow or well holding water supplies created containment rather than unbounded flow.
Water overflowing its bound supplies a material model for transgression.
Returning rain or water supplies cyclical return after apparent independence.
Water settling at the flood's endpoint supplies a bounded receiving basin.
A water vessel supplies portable containment at the final approach.

changed_reading.before: Reading is a linear intake of information.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, read as a timed circulation of gathered meaning whose health depends on containment, whose corruption is overflow, and whose course returns toward its source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is an acoustic rather than syntactic reconstruction, activated by recitation, repeated iqra, voice, echo, and raised call. It remains anchored in the focus's oral-reading branch and the literal repetition of the imperative. Downstream prose should call it a sound-pattern model, not claim that iqra itself means echo.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus imperative can be oral recitation, so later repetition and sound-return branches can alter its temporal and relational shape.

activation_trace.role: Oral reading and recitation supply the initial voiced event.
The repeated recitation command supplies a second sounding of the opening voice.
Singing and voice activate the audible register inside the self-sufficiency sequence.
Repeated sound and echo turn return into an acoustic response rather than only a destination.
The reach of a raised voice extends recitation from a private sound into contested public space.

changed_reading.before: Iqra is a single utterance emitted by an isolated speaker.
changed_reading.after: Iqra becomes a voiced response that is repeated, travels publicly, and returns like an echo rather than terminating in the speaker.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses non-dominant split-root branches for ism and a closure branch for khalaqa. It remains anchored in the actual bi-smi construction, the reading imperative, and the packet's mapped inventories; the pen and knowledge marks provide contextual reinforcement. Downstream prose should frame the Name-as-aperture as a spatial metaphor for oriented access, never as a replacement gloss for ism.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Bi-smi sits between iqra and rabbika, permitting the name to function figuratively as the oriented opening through which reading reaches what the Creator has formed.

activation_trace.role: Reading and reciting supply the motion that requires an oriented route of access.
A narrow opening of entry supplies the spatial aperture activated at bi-smi.
An intended direction and probed depth make the aperture orient inquiry rather than merely admit it.
An imperforate closure supplies the resistant surface whose access cannot be assumed.
A distinguishing, guiding mark makes oriented access epistemic rather than merely spatial.
Cutting and trimming a hard thing supplies the material act by which a legible opening or edge is prepared.

changed_reading.before: The Name is only a label pronounced before reading.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the Name is the orienting aperture through which reading enters and probes a formed but otherwise closed order.

strongest_changes: The opening moved from bare recitation to explicitly sourced speech whose attribution resists the later fiction of self-sufficiency.
Teaching by the pen made creation and inscription co-readable as measured, marked formation.
The prohibition-prayer sequence turned iqra into allegiance within competing commands, and the final prostration and approach made that allegiance bodily.
Attachment strongly reinforced a coexisting gestational reading in which meaning is retained and developed before it emerges.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive latent crossings were q-r-hamza as gathering and gestational enclosure, ism's split mapping into visible sign, and kh-l-q's polarity between measured origination and fabricated speech. These let epistemic, biological, social, and embodied readings coexist without reducing iqra to a single gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The gathering and womb branches may be deliberate material analogies or only productive lexical resonance; the context strengthens them without deciding between those possibilities.
The non-dominant w-s-m and s-m-m mappings visibly change the reading of bi-smi, but they should remain activation cues rather than asserted etymologies.
The acoustic-return and hydrological models are coherent across several branches yet remain cross-domain reconstructions, not direct semantic paraphrases.
